recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up FHIR core source work is needed for FHIR-11256 unless a future editorial decision changes how the developer overview introduces supported serializations.
issue_request: FHIR-11256 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request for the DSTU2/1.6.0 developer overview asking the text to say resources are represented as XML, JSON, or RDF and to reflect 110 current resource types instead of older XML/JSON-only and 109-resource wording.
initial_application: The Jira snapshot records Grahame Grieve's application note as svn revision ~10265. Git-svn history shows the matching source change in commit 757fa87a289594daefce8c7cd484c1101daaac28 at build@10266, which changed source/overview-dev.html from XML/JSON-only wording to XML, JSON, or RDF. The count was already represented in source as <%resourcecount%>, avoiding a hard-coded resource count.
additional_context: source/overview-dev.html remains an active top-level overview page linked from source/documentation.html, source/index.html, and source/modules.html. Later source history refined the same paragraph to distinguish resource instances from resource types and then changed the RDF link label to RDF (Turtle), consistent with the current RDF representation page. Exact Jira searches found only FHIR-11256 for this RDF/resource-count request, and quoted Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant or conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source already satisfies the final issue request by naming XML, JSON, and RDF (Turtle), linking to the RDF representation page, and using the generated current resource count.
